description: Read-only polling for a known SocialSeal async run, export, or group refresh. UUID auto ids are journey runs; numeric auto ids are AI answer runs (Google AI, ChatGPT, Gemini or Claude). Both are workspace-scoped, as are google_ai_run, journey_run, explore_run, and video_analysis. Pass the workspaceId from the lookup that returned the run. MCP-host errors such as "No approval received" occur before SocialSeal executes this tool; never describe them as SocialSeal billing, workspace approval, or job-status errors.

workspaceId.description: Pass the workspace from the lookup that returned this run id. Required for auto/google_ai_run/journey/explore/video polls unless the user can reach only one workspace.

name: socialseal_get_tool_status
title: Get SocialSeal tool status
